metadata.article_title: When enumerated articles not deemed specifically bequeathed.

article.title: When enumerated articles not deemed specifically bequeathed.
article.content: Where a will contains a bequest of the residue of the testator's property along with an enumeration of some items of property not previously bequeathed, the articles enumerated shall not be deemed to be specifically bequeathed.
article.html:
146When enumerated articles not deemed specifically bequeathed.

Section 146 · Part VI · Chapter XIV · page 54 of the Act

Where a will contains a bequest of the residue of the testator's property along with an enumeration of some items of property not previously bequeathed, the articles enumerated shall not be deemed to be specifically bequeathed.
